create_multibody_with_links: create a PyBullet multi-body with revolute joints and linked collision shapes
create_collision_shapes: create sphere and box collision shapes using PyBullet GEOM_SPHERE and GEOM_BOX
change_dynamics_friction: change dynamics properties like spinning friction, rolling friction, and linear damping on a body
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control to VELOCITY_CONTROL with a target velocity and force
get_joint_info: get the number of joints and joint info for a PyBullet multi-body object
